assignmentHtml.task: Research El Reino Infantil YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: Puchika Kids S.A.S. or related Colombian entity. Corporate chain. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages (Spanish). (6) Primary content category (children's nursery rhymes/animation). (7) Content supply model: commissioned children's animation. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: El Reino Infantil is #23 with ~75B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for El Reino Infantil with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
El Reino Infantil — Comprehensive Dossier

1. Stable Channel ID and Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCK1i2UviaXLUNrZlAFpw_jA
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/c/elreinoinfantil (also accessible at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCK1i2UviaXLUNrZlAFpw_jA)
  • Confirmed via SocialBlade, HypeAuditor, and YouTube's own URLs SocialBlade · HypeAuditor · YouTube

2. Operator and Corporate Chain

  • Operator: Leader Entertainment (formerly Leader Music), founded in 1983 by Roberto "Kuky" Pumar. Leader Entertainment is the parent company that owns and operates the El Reino Infantil brand and its 50+ YouTube channels.
  • NOT Puchika Kids S.A.S.: After exhaustive searching in both English and Spanish across Google, LinkedIn, corporate registries, and industry publications, no entity named "Puchika Kids S.A.S." appears anywhere in public records or media coverage related to El Reino Infantil. This entity could not be verified and may be erroneous. All credible sources consistently identify Leader Entertainment / Roberto Pumar as the operator.
  • Corporate structure: Three business divisions — Content Creation, Live Theater & Experiences, Licensing Development. Affiliated LinkedIn page: Leader Entertainment (Buenos Aires) LinkedIn · Wikitubia · Wikipedia

3. Channel Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel created: June 2, 2011 SocialBlade · Wikitubia Timeline
  • Earliest still-public upload: "La Gallina Turuleca - Canciones de la Granja de Zenón 1" — uploaded June 17, 2011, with 1.3B+ views, 3.5M likes. This is the oldest video still publicly accessible on the main channel YouTube
  • Note: The very first uploads on the channel (June 3–7, 2011, the María Elena Walsh series including "Manuelita la Tortuga") have all been deleted per Wikipedia Wikipedia.

4. Operating Location and Displayed Country

  • Headquarters: Buenos Aires, Argentina (San José 1277, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires 1136, AR) LinkedIn
  • Additional office: Madrid, Spain SenalNews · Todotvnews
  • Displayed country: Argentina — confirmed as an Argentine channel by Wikipedia, LinkedIn, YouTube's own blog ("From Argentina to the world"), and industry profiles Wikipedia · YouTube Blog · Aldia News

5. Languages

  • Primary language: Spanish
  • Network reach: 11 languages — Spanish, English, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, Turkish, Russian, Romanian, Korean, and Hindi Todotvnews · SenalNews
  • The main channel displays content primarily in Spanish, with translated versions distributed across the network's 50 channels Todotvnews

6. Primary Content Category

  • Children's nursery rhymes and animation (Wikipedia infobox categorizes genres as "education, nursery rhymes" Wikipedia)
  • Content combines animated music videos for preschoolers with educational programming developed with guidance from educational psychologists SenalNews
  • LinkedIn lists specialties: YouTube, Animation, Entertainment, Digital Platforms, Social Media, Licensing, Music, Kids Content LinkedIn

7. Content Supply Model: Commissioned/Co-Produced Children's Animation

  • Origin model: Initially added visual animation to existing traditional children's song catalogs (e.g., María Elena Walsh repertoire, "Susanita tiene un ratón," "La vaca lechera," "La gallina turuleca") Aldia News · Audiovisual From Spain
  • Evolution: Moved into original IP creation (La Granja de Zenón, Bichikids, Canciones del Zoo, etc.) Wikipedia
  • Current model: Digital-first co-production and commissioning. Partnerships with studios such as Mediawan Kids & Family (Wadoo, 39 episodes, co-produced) and CAKE Entertainment (Pili Pilota) Variety · Todotvnews
  • Also offers third-party distribution and sales agency services for production companies seeking YouTube expansion Audiovisual From Spain
  • Uses analytics-driven soft-launch strategy: social media shorts test characters/storytelling before full series commitment, leveraging AI tools alongside human creative control Variety

8. Representative Works (with view counts)

Series Debut Notes Representative Video
La Granja de Zenón June 17, 2011 Flagship franchise; Bartolito the Rooster, La Vaca Lola, Percherón Wikipedia La Gallina Turuleca (1.3B views)
Rondas y Clásicos Infantiles April 2012 Classic nursery rhymes series Wikipedia Canciones y Clásicos (188M views)
Las Canciones del Zoo August 2013 Zoo-themed songs with Sammy El Heladero Wikipedia Networked across channel
Paco el Marinero November 2014 Sailor adventure series Wikipedia El Marinero Baila (1B+ views)
Michi-Guau December 2014 Cat/dog-themed series Wikipedia —
La Familia Blu January 2015 Dog family series Wikipedia —
Bichikids Late 2015 Insect-themed educational songs (To-To el Hormiguito) Wikipedia —
Wadoo 2026–2027 (upcoming) Co-produced with Mediawan Kids & Family; 39-episode preschool IP Variety —

Key Metrics (as of ~September 2026)

  • Main channel: ~71.5M subscribers, ~75B lifetime views SocialBlade · HypeAuditor
  • Total network: 240M+ subscribers across 50 channels, 180B+ lifetime views Todotvnews

Unresolved Issues

  • "Puchika Kids S.A.S.": No verifiable evidence of this entity exists in any public source consulted. It does not appear on LinkedIn, YouTube, Google, corporate registries, or industry publications. The orchestrator's attribution of this entity as the operator is unsupported and likely incorrect. The verified operator is Leader Entertainment (Argentina).
